full_prompt_en: A square surreal photographic image shows a close group of cloaked figures carrying a precarious stack of pale sheep beneath a smoky gray sky. A low, almost empty horizon divides the misty background from a dark strip of ground along the bottom edge. On the left, a diffuse yellow glow opens through heavy cloud and gradually fades into cooler charcoal on the right. The figures occupy the lower center as a compact mass of nearly black coats, long skirts, hoods, and partly hidden legs. Their faces are mostly concealed by the animals, fabric, and shadow, so the group reads first as a procession of dark vertical shapes. One sheep's head extends toward the open space on the left at shoulder height. Above it, several woolly bodies overlap at different levels, their rounded backs forming an uneven staircase. A pale animal near the top stands across the others with its head turned right; another projects its head toward the right edge of the group. Cream wool is dense and softly curled, with small dark facial marks and legs emerging from the overlapping forms. Near the right side, a cloaked figure holds a thin horizontal staff, and a small ocher rectangular object hangs against the dark clothing. The stack is strange and physically tense, yet the bodies beneath it remain still. The lower garments merge into deep shadow just above the narrow ground plane. Light comes from the cloud opening at upper left, catching the tops and left edges of the wool while leaving the folds of clothing almost black. A fine, slightly rough photographic grain and atmospheric haze soften the distance, while the sheep retain more tactile detail than the obscured figures. The overall composition balances a luminous, irregular tower against a broad dark sky and empty margins, creating a solemn, dreamlike mood.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形超现实摄影式画面呈现一群紧挨着的披斗篷人物，在烟灰色天空下托着一叠摇摇欲坠的浅色羊。低而几乎空旷的地平线将迷雾背景与下缘一道深色地面分开。左侧，漫散的黄色光从厚云中透出，并向右逐渐退入更冷的炭灰色。人物聚在下部中央，形成由近黑色外套、长裙、兜帽和半隐的腿组成的紧密团块。他们的脸大多被羊、布料和阴影遮住，因此这群人首先呈现为一列深色竖向形体。一只羊的头在肩膀高度伸向左侧的开阔空间。其上，几只毛茸茸的身体在不同高度互相遮叠，圆润的背部形成不整齐的阶梯。靠近顶端的一只浅色羊横跨其他羊，头转向右方；另一只也将头伸向人群右侧。奶油色羊毛浓密而微卷，小片深色面部标记和腿从重叠形体中露出。右侧附近，一名披斗篷者持着一根细长的水平杖，一件赭色的小长方形物件贴在深色衣服前。叠置的羊显得奇异而紧绷，下面的人体却保持静止。下方衣摆在狭窄地面上方融入深影。光从左上方的云隙射来，照亮羊毛的顶部和左缘，衣物褶皱则几乎沉入黑色。细微而略粗糙的摄影颗粒与空气雾气软化远处，羊的触感细节比隐没的人物更清晰。整体构图以发亮且不规则的高耸形体对照大片深色天空与空旷边缘，形成肃穆如梦的气氛。
style_prompt_en: The photographic image combines muted charcoal, slate gray, yellowed cream, and small earthy ocher accents. Dense dark masses gather low in the frame, while pale rounded forms overlap above them and emerge clearly against a broad smoky field. The edges of nearer light forms retain tactile, fine detail; darker forms lose their boundaries in folded shadow and atmospheric haze. A diffuse opening of warm light on one side fades into cool, heavy gray across the rest of the image, creating directional modeling without hard cast shadows. Subtle photographic grain and a matte, weathered tonal surface prevent the smooth areas from feeling polished. The space is shallow around the main cluster but expands into quiet negative space at the margins. Contrasts of compact weight and open air, soft volume and obscured silhouette give the image a solemn, surreal stillness.
style_prompt_zh: 摄影式画面结合低饱和炭黑、石板灰、泛黄奶油色与少量土赭色重音。密集的深色团块聚在画幅下部，浅色圆润形体在其上层层遮叠，并从宽阔烟灰色区域中清晰浮现。近处浅色形体的边缘保留细密触感，深色形体的边界则消失在折叠的阴影与空气雾气中。一侧漫散的暖光向画面其余部分沉重的冷灰渐隐，形成有方向的体积塑造，却没有坚硬投影。细微摄影颗粒和哑光、风化的明度表面让平滑区域不显得光洁。主要形体团周围的空间较浅，但在边缘延展为安静的留白。紧实重量与开阔空气、柔和体积与模糊剪影之间的对比，赋予画面肃穆而超现实的静止感。
theme_en: Cloaked figures bearing a precarious tower of sheep beneath a stormy sky
theme_zh: 暴风雨天空下，披斗篷的人群托起层叠的羊
name: Leszek Bujnowski
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
